senses.gloss: (cmp. אָבַר Pi.) wings or corners of city walls (h. פִּנָּה), pinnacles, mural turrets.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 11a:2">Sabb. 11ᵃ</cite> ed. (Ar. <he>אברוארי</he>, read <he>אבראורי</he>; Ms. M. <he>אַוְרַוְרֵי</he>; Var. lect. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note)

senses.gloss: (v. אֵבֶר a. חֶבֶר) balance, freight arranged for balancing, ballast.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 24b:1">B. Bath. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>אימור באברוו׳ הוו מנחי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>באברו׳</he>) I may say, the small kegs were placed among the large for balancing purposes.
